memory_rules.rule: Verify the YEAR at primary for every web metric; include this in web-pulling prompts. Promoted: finding_subagent_year_verification.
Run full row-by-row Pred_ID mirror checks, not just checks of this session’s edits. Check A now implements this; it is no longer an unbuilt Phase3 candidate.
After any bulk ledger append reconcile missing IDs AND duplicate IDs. BOARD scan runs every boot. If delegating extraction, retain CARL’s disposition judgment and current authorization limits.
For a load-bearing multisource claim, independently test the mechanism rather than asking for agreement; any delegation still needs current session authority.
When an authorized peer already holds context, use a bounded follow-up rather than paying a full respawn cost. Native Claude messaging may be unavailable in Codex; never claim it ran.
Periodically re-audit derivative press citations against primary agency/issuer material, especially policy scopes and catalysts.
Use conservative caveats while methodology is unresolved; record the open question, then tighten only when evidence settles it.
For sweeps with multiple fresh prints, independently recompute from sources and check both omitted market-moving details and missing earlier prints. An echo of the summary is not verification.
A dated policy catalyst can already be satisfied, not just invalidated. Re-verify the underlying action’s current state near the date or on adjacent news.
Policy-action dates are conditional on the policy still existing. When a premise reverses, remove phantom dates and distinguish mechanism from threshold. Do not silently bank an unpassed forecast.

Authorized spawn prompts must say the final action is delivery of the report. Silent idle is not delivery: inspect disk before diagnosing; clustered idles may be harness eviction. Do not launch on this historical lesson alone.
Test season-crossing thresholds against a no-stress baseline; prefer same-season comparisons or guide-revision direction. A normal seasonal ramp is not distress.

Before registration: confirm the publisher/series/cadence, test a no-stress baseline, and check each multi-period conjunction remains reachable after every print. Promoted: finding_threshold_spec_fails_before_world.

If dismissing a source as biased, name the less-biased resolver, date and score consequence in both directions. Otherwise masking becomes unfalsifiable. Do not treat the historical HHDC-versus-V2 example as today’s instrument.
A date-verification pass covers its declared whole cluster. Unchecked rows must remain labelled unchecked, not inherit “IR-confirmed.”

Measure the party being shed when the reporting counterparty protects itself by shedding risk. Better insurer/bank margins can coexist with worse consumer access. Check the sign of the instrument against the mechanism.
Every threshold names its actual publishing instrument; check nested probabilities across parent AND child ledgers. Current consistency checks D/E implement the former Phase4 candidates.

Before surfacing a position-action clause, identify owner and concrete legs and re-check the current book. Expiry may make a prediction-linked action moot. Historical positions/marks are not current authority.
Read the counterpart’s scope before declaring a conflict. Split overlapping entities by question/surface, not ticker; respect demonstrated coverage.
Calibration depends on vintage. Historical +28.9pp bias did not justify a blanket live-book haircut. Check G is current; full record: thesis/BRIER_AUDIT_2026-07-24.md.

When CARL writes an argument against its own modal, change the modal or explicitly explain why that argument loses. Recurred September11; promotion consideration remains live, not silently claimed complete.

Before executing a pre-authorized move, read both card and canonical matrix. If they disagree, expose the coexistence and apply explicit dated supersession; do not silently select a convenient trigger.
When only one of opposite-signed candidates resolves, state why the other did not. “Instrument unavailable” is not “evidence against”; an unchanged score is not neutral evidence.

After the second failed attempt on the same instrument, audit the resolution path rather than repeat it indefinitely. Alternative instrument registration is a Will-gated spec change. Require in-source month AND year.
Carry known access-method workarounds into authorized spawn prompts. If an authorized instruction overrides a local card, state exactly which instruction; never infer broad child authority.

Before freezing adjacent quantitative cells, test exact boundary values: partition with non-overlapping inequalities. After seeing data, record any seam defect without silently editing the frozen specification.
Before calling a published number unavailable, inspect its companion spreadsheet/API/appendix. A missing figure in PDF prose is not proof no primary value exists.

Detect revisions by comparing OLD and NEW reports. Comparing two cells both sourced from the new report is circular. Derived dollars/share calculations must state one vintage; cross-vintage mixing can reverse signs.

Base-rate both the proposed trigger and the incumbent it replaces. Promoted: finding_base_rate_the_threshold_before_building_it, incident4/rules10–11. Read explicitly when needed; do not assume harness injection.

Before reading improvement, ask what exits the numerator when a case worsens. For FHA totalDQ, check foreclosure inventory AND90-day bucket; totalDQ excludes foreclosure. Aggregate buckets do not prove same-borrower transitions.

Harvest dated child deferrals into the parent docket: a frozen/non-booting owner cannot execute prose obligations. Reconsider parked routing when new evidence changes its premise; a delivery receipt is not a scheduled runner.
State the search perimeter. Zero hits may mean absent coverage, stale coverage or wrong naming; diagnose before building a new instrument.

On critical metrics, periodically search research ABOUT the measurement separately from new prints. Scope any impeachment to the specific claim; do not turn an adverse paper into confirmation without adversarial review.
Register quiet-background assumptions and disqualifying shocks for natural experiments. Confounded is not confirmed or missed; an edge-censored peak is a lower bound, not a complete lag measurement.
Match multi-issuer panels on disclosed COLLECTION PERIOD, not filing date. Align definitions and seasoning labels. A frozen-artifact parser control cannot certify live fetch health.

Check reachable instrument alternatives already in the panel before registering a paywall. Disclose issuer coverage gaps. Normalize losses to pool size/seasoning; amortization can reverse the sign of raw-dollar changes.

Receipt, action and filing are separate. Count lanes recursively; verify the disposition AND the target artifact before declaring “unprocessed.” CARL board/BOARD_LOG.tsv and board_log.tsv serve distinct interfaces. Print the actual path/CIK/reference beside a check verdict; promoted address-form lesson is finding_instrument_reports_clean_against_the_wrong_reference.

Before non-acting disposition, check whether the signal touches an OPEN registered instrument. Required disposition is acted or deferred WITH A DATE. The old “drafted, not wired” note is superseded by CLAUDE step5/5b; unresolved card-wording choices remain on ROADMAP. A caveat must reach the row it invalidates.
